keyFindings.description: Marker branch tests startsWith('unset ') before the '=' test and skips to the next ';\n': (a) a set entry named 'unset X' (`unset X="v"; export unset X;`) is consumed as a marker and silently kept (in neither kept nor dropped); (b) a marker line without ';' (`unset GONE\n`) swallows the next entry. Verified through the head's real parseShellEnvironment. Not creatable by a shell (bash refuses `export 'unset X'=1`; tmux always prints `unset NAME;`) — only a crafted execve envp or a broken tmux — but the docstring's 'anything else is a parse failure' does not hold for them. Fix: compute eq/lineEnd first; marker branch only when the line has no '=' and ends with ';' before its newline; one parser test. Parser-only; no rig run needed. Architect decides whether to fold it in before the .legion/ deletion; if so I re-review gates-only.

`new Set(await environmentNames(...))` with an undefined re-list (server/session vanished between the last -u and the re-list) is an empty set: the global table refuses under the misleading message 'allow-listed name(s) now missing: HOME, PATH, …'; a vanished session is reported as a clean scrub (benign). Throw 'table vanished during the scrub' on undefined for honesty.

A name beginning '-' (enters a table only from a forking environ) is refused by tmux's flag parser on -u → throw → boot refusal naming the name; fail-closed, loud; `-u -- <name>` would remove it. Optional.
